## Introduction

finds the beak volume by multiplying the beak length by the beak depth and dividing it by two (for triangle purposes)

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

## Loading everything in

```{python}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
import pandas as pd
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
penguins = load_penguins()

```

## Removing NAs

```{python}
clean_penguins = penguins.dropna()

```

## Calculations

```{python}
clean_penguins["bill_size_mm_squared"] = clean_penguins["bill_length_mm"] * clean_penguins["bill_depth_mm"] /2
clean_penguins
```

# Plotting

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-beak-size
#| fig-cap: "Beak size of penguins by species."
clean_penguins.boxplot(column="bill_size_mm_squared", by="species")
plt.suptitle("")
plt.ylabel("Beak Size")
plt.show()
```
